title: The Pen & Sword ICE Detention Map

facilities.title: Nationwide ICE civil detention facility locations
facilities.scope: Facilities that held at least one ICE civil immigration detainee Jan 1, 2025–Mar 10, 2026, plus newly disclosed openings. Includes dedicated facilities, jails, hold rooms, staging sites and hospitals. Not an assertion of current operation. Excludes criminal-only immigration detention and generally excludes CBP-only and ORR facilities.
facilities.contactCoverage: 14 facility-code records across 12 physical sites have operator main lines checked on 2026-10-26. All other records link to the ICE directory. Calls were not tested. Operator main lines are not direct detainee lines.

deaths.title: Deaths in ICE custody: documented source records
deaths.publisher: UCLA Law Behind Bars Data Project / Andrew Free
deaths.coverageNote: Historical documented deaths, not a complete real-time census. No linked record means not documented here, not zero deaths. Excludes many deaths after release, during enforcement, in CBP custody, and people never formally booked into ICE. Reporting delays and source limitations apply.
deaths.locationNote: All mapped facility attributes identify the last associated detention facility. Actual reported death location is separately retained.
deaths.countNote: Record counts are not mortality rates or findings of preventability, negligence, or responsibility. Do not rank facility safety from these counts.

districts.legalContentAuditStatus: Not a complete district-by-district substantive rules or citator audit. Retrieval dates do not establish legal currency.
districts.sourceType: Official federal district court websites; directory retrieval audit

privacy: No personal-identifier lookup, analytics, external map tiles or geolocation. Searches run in the browser.
limitations: Inventory is recorded use, not a live active-facility census.
Null coordinates stay searchable without a fabricated pin.
Counts of deaths are records, not mortality rates or findings of causation.
Last associated detention facility can differ from the place of death.
Court source retrieval is not a complete substantive habeas, local-rule, judge-order or case-law audit.
